# SummarizedExperiment vs Anndata specification 

- rowData -- features (var)
- colData -- samples (obs)
- assays -- counts (X)
- metadata (unstructured)


Option 1:

Identify type of column by prefix:
e.g. "label_<name>"

- "label_entrez_id" -> entrez id

Option 2:

Store mappings in metadata

exploreDE$var$label <- "entrez_id"
exploreDE$obs$label <- "sample_label"


We show how it might look like if we encode type as column prefix.

# rowData -- features (var)

There can be many rowData tables, One feature Annotation Table (same for all DE tests in this SE)

all columns can be used for filtering/subsetting
type of column either string, integer, or numeric, different types of filtering depending on type

## exploreDE feature annotation table

- ID column -- hardcoded, match rownames of all assays 
  - Unique per row 
  - Gene ID 
  - Protein ID
  - Whatever 
- Annotations (for filtering/subsetting): 
  - Labels - prefix "label_" optional, not hardcoded, not unique per row 
      - Gene symbol e.g. "label_gene_symbol" <string>
      - Entrez ID e.g. "label_entrez_id" or "label_Entrez ID"<string>
      - Ensembl gene ID e.g. "label_ensembl_gene_id" <string> 
      - UniProtID e.g. "label_uniprot_id" <string>
      - FlyDBID e.g. "label_flydb_id" <string>
      - Assignment method (metabolomics, e.g., library_MS1, library_MS2, manual annotation) e.g. "assignment_method"
      - nrPeptides e.g. label_nr_peptides <numeric>
      - Global baseMean e.g. label_global_base_mean <numeric>
      - ... 

  - Description  -- hardcoded "description"
      - Text about the gene (searchable)
  


## DE Tables (1 per DE test performed)

- DE Results:
  - Required prefix "Effect_" (For the volcano plot x-axis)
    - Log2fc -- `log2Ratio`, `log2FC`, `grep("^log2")`, `lfc` <numeric>
    
  - Required Scores, (one or more) prefix "score_" :
    - Raw p-value -- "score_p-value" <numeric>
    - Adjusted p-value/FDR/q-value -- "score_adjusted_p_val","score_FDR","score_q-value" <numeric>
  
  - Optional "label_<name>" either <numeric> or <string>
    - Model name <string>
    - DE baseMean <numeric>
      - for MA plot (e.g. DESeq2:`rowData(metadata(se)$nativeResult$dds)$baseMean`, edgeR:`metadata(se)$nativeResult$AveLogCPM`)
    - t-statistic <numeric>
    - number of missing values <numeric>
    - confidence interval upper, lower <numeric>
    - ... 


Also specify which Factor from the colData was used for the DE test!
Also specify which Abundance was used for the DE test!


# colData -- samples (anndata - obs)

- "sample_id" (required, first column, matches colnames of all assays)
- sample name "sample_label" unique per sample
- b-fabric sample ID "b-fabric_sample_id" unique per sample
- Explanatory variables "factor_<name>" -- E.g., condition, sex, grouping, treatment, batch, timepoint, genotype
  - We also need to know which factor[s] column was used as the basis for DE 
  - How to handle categorical vs numerical factors for plotting? 
  - Store this in the metadata? Or in the colData with a special colname? 
- Organism 
- Feature level (isoform/gene, peptide/protein)
- ... 
  - Read counts
  - Creatinine concentration

# Assays -- counts (x)

We must annotate which of the abundances was used for the DE test!

- raw "raw_<name>" (required, only 1) (in linear space, not normalised) 
- normalised abundance "normalized_<name>" (at 0 - 1) (linear space, normalised) - no need for this in in proteomics/metabolomics
    - TPM 
- transformed abundance "transformed_<name>"(at least 1) (log space, normalised or unnormalised) 
  - log2 TPM 
  - VST, voom, vsn, etc


- "label_<name>" <numeric> or <string>
  - E.g., number of peptides per sample etc.
  - E.g., SD of the abundances, retention time 


# Metadata (unstructured)

We did had a look at ClusterProfiler's enrichResult object.
and at string-db web-api.

- Pathway analyses 
  - clusterProfiler gseaResult/enrichResult objects 
  - Alternative data frame:
    - GO category 
    - GO IDs as rows 
    - GO description 
    - Number of genes mapped 
    - Number of genes in set 
    - Enrichment Score
    - FDR 
    - Method
    - Feature lists (genes, protein IDs)
      - Mapped IDs (row data ID)
      - Internal IDs
      - ... 
- sampleGroup
- Only for genomics:
  - refGroup
  - groupingName
  - can be removed if using the proposed format (as it'll be in the DE rowData name[s])
- comparison
- featureLevel
- runGO -- should be removed/replaced by searching in metadata(se)
- fdrThreshORA -- should be removed/replaced by manual thresholding 
- fdrThreshGSEA -- should be removed/replaced by manual thresholding
- pValThreshGO -- not necessary, can be removed 
- log2RatioThreshGO -- not necessary, can be removed 
- backgroundExpression -- is used and derived from sushi currently 
- refBuild -- only used for KEGG, as well as FPKM/TPM generation 

# Tab requirements 

In case of missing data PCA methods exist that are computationally intensive. Hence precomputing and storing those matrices migth be required.


- DE tabs -- requires the DE rowData tables, metadata
  - DE summary
  - Volcano plot
  - ORA/GSEA 
  - GO tile plot 
  - KEGG
- Pure visualisation tabs -- requires feature rowData, colData, assays
  - PCA plot
  - Heatmap
  - Boxplot
  - Correlation plot 
- Can show certain tabs using something like:
  - `condition = "output.test=='exploreDE'"`
